title: Elite: Bargain the Debt Furnace Treasury: Antechamber Seal
description: Elite: Bargain the Debt Furnace Treasury: Antechamber Seal is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate (Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses). One selected deity from Lucifer, Lilith, Asmodeus, Naamah enters; this beat spotlights Lucifer as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the pre boss step at Debt Furnace Treasury, using infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Infernal Dominion is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Black-Iron Debt Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Debt Furnace Treasury and reveals: How repeated mistakes become chains. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Debt Furnace Treasury configured as a pre boss space inside infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway; source-culture appearance layer: black iron courts, volcanic glass aisles, ember chain channels, debtor seal floors, contract dais, obsidian throne shadows; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Goetic chain-crown blades, volcanic glass debtor plates, blood-wax infernal ledger cores, chain-lien reversals
